description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 24.07.2017 to 30.07.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory matter under the Customs Ordinance. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges will be calculated based on currency exchange rates.
